title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook | Sea Foam Green | 2-1/2-Inch Extension Brass Wall Mount | Allied Brass | Classic Bath Accessory | Allied Brass
description:
Add hanging space exactly where you need it—then tuck it away in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. This traditional retractable wall hook is a space-saving choice for traditional bathroom hardware, giving you a convenient spot for towels, robes, or clothing while keeping the wall profile cleaner when not in use.

Highlights:
- Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Hold everyday items securely: rated to support up to 15 lb
- Coordinate with existing hardware: the supplied knob tip can be removed and replaced with a cabinet knob of your choice
- Built for standard walls: toggle mounting hardware is included for interior drywall

Specs & Installation:
- Material: brass
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Overall size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L
- Projection: 1"
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Weight capacity: 15 lb
- Installation requirements: drill one 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around; all mounting hardware included (6/32 toggles)
- Styling: traditional—ideal for classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures
- Finish variety: multiple designer finish options available, including statement colors
